mini.icons
Question
Is there a complete overview of all the mini.icons available somewhere?
For instance, here is an overview of all atom material icons: https://plugins.jetbrains.com/plugin/10044-atom-material-icons

comment_data.body:
Kind of, but depends on what is meant by "overview". Here is the [part of source code](https://github.com/echasnovski/mini.nvim/blob/e744b5dbb3158242af77124bd6763a8647ea82ed/lua/mini/icons.lua#L693-L1964) that contains all built-in icon definitions.

To get this programmatically, there is [`list()`](https://github.com/echasnovski/mini.nvim/blob/e744b5dbb3158242af77124bd6763a8647ea82ed/doc/mini-icons.txt#L448) to list all available icons for specific category and [`get()`]() to get the data. For example, here is how to see all built-in LSP icons and their highlight group: `=vim.tbl_map(function(name) return { name, MiniIcons.get('lsp', name) } end, MiniIcons.list('lsp'))`.

Note, that both 'file' or 'extension' categories use [fallback to matched filetype](https://github.com/echasnovski/mini.nvim/blob/e744b5dbb3158242af77124bd6763a8647ea82ed/doc/mini-icons.txt#L117-L124) which means that actual coverage in these categories is much larger.
